channel.title: K107FM Fife Travel Alerts
channel.description: Live Traffic Scotland updates for Fife

item.title: M90 J06 Kinross (Northbound)
item.description:
🟠 Traffic restriction
• The M90 is currently closed heading northbound between Junction 5 and Junction 6, due to planned works on the carriageway. This closure is inclusive of the J5 northbound on slip.
Updated: 19:17

item.title: A90/A928 (Southbound)
item.description:
🟠 Traffic restriction
• The A90 southbound off slip at Gateside is closed due to overnight roadworks. The southbound on slip is also closed.
Updated: 19:36

item.title: A92 Crossgates (General)
item.description:
🟠 Traffic restrictions
• There will be no access to the A92 from the off slip for the M90 at J2a heading north, due to an overnight closure of the link road.
Updated: 19:59
